snippet.title: Castle Conquer II for the TI-99/4A
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

---


Game description:

A homebrew platformer and sequel to Castle Conquer.

Again, the fair maiden needs to be rescued by Eric. Thus the player has to jump over hurdles and, new to Castle Conquer II, duck from incoming hurdles such as arrows. There are also guillotines now which need perfect timing to go under.

A much more difficult game than the first Castle Conquer.
